newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair, AUA take stake in UIA.
newsitem.headline: Swissair, AUA take stake in UIA.

text.p: Swissair AG and Austrian Airlines (AUA) have jointly taken a 18.37 percent stake in Ukraine International Airlines (UIA), Swissair said.
A statement from Swissair said the stake was acquired through UIA Beteiligungs GmbH, a Swissair-AUA joint venture set up for this purpose.
UIA was founded in 1992 and became profitable in 1995.
It is based in Kiev and serves 12 cities in Western Europe, including Zurich and Vienna, with a fleet of three Boeing 737 aircraft.
It expects to transport 200,000 passengers in 1996.
Swissair serves the Zurich-Kiev route five times weekly in a codeshare agreement with UIA, while UIA operates a single weekly flight to Zurich on its own.
